links.comparator_used: Phase 1 loosely structured prompt without encoded ESA kinetics, iron dosing rules, and timing safeguards
links.outcome: Protocol adherence of ESA and IV iron recommendations, as judged by two nephrologists (300 simulated cases per phase)
links.effect: Phase 2 deterministic prompt 300/300 (100%) adherent vs Phase 1 96/300 (32%); p < 0.001; eliminated protocol deviations, unsafe iron dosing and timing violations
links.quote: In Phase 2, deterministic encoding achieved full protocol adherence (300/300, 100%), eliminating unsafe or premature recommendations (p < 0.001 vs. Phase 1) and consistently generating structured, rationale-based outputs.

links.comparator_used: Phase 1 loosely structured prompt with open-ended output
links.outcome: Protocol adherence and consistency of structured, rationale-based outputs
links.effect: Phase 2 (fixed six clinical inputs, deterministic prompt logic) 300/300 (100%) adherent vs Phase 1 96/300 (32%); p < 0.001
links.quote: In Phase 1, loosely structured prompting produced variable outputs, with only 96 of 300 simulated cases (32%) fully protocol-adherent and frequent unsafe recommendations.

design_hint: deterministic prompt logic with embedded safety alerts and timing safeguards
